tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sngags 'chang chen po nas bzung gdung brgyud rim can gyi ri rgya klung rgya la thugs gal shin tu che bar mdzad pa ma zad ngos kyi kyang sa phag lo ri rgya klung rgya'i bca' tshe gsal bkrams sa la'ang khrims gcod byas na 'gal ba khung rdol yod pa'i nges pa nged rang gi shin tu gsal ba rnyed kyang de bzhin gyi rgyu mtshan gling tshe kun la phog 'gal du 'gro ba las mi 'dug pas las ngan bzlog med la mchog gsum rin po che mkhyen snyam pa'i bsam pa tsam las gzhan bya thabs ma rnyed/ lhag par yab rje rdo rje 'chang gi dgongs gzhi gdung brgyud rin po che rgyun mi chad pa'i rten 'brel du ngang phrug rdzi bo re ched mngags bsko bzhag mdzad nas rgyun dang mgo thon bstun bza' btung gsol ras phangs med gnang ba yin kyang rgyu 'bras bsam med rnams nas zhabs 'gyur zhe thag ma byung zhing / nged rang gi thog la yang spyan ltos bzang po'i sngar rgyun bzhin byas kyang rdzi mi bsam med rnams nas las kho na gtso don gyi ngang pa pho mo du ma gsang ba'i ngang phrug rnams lhan du sgril ba'i/ de dag kyang mtshan mo khyi dang zhun bu/ nyin mo bya rog dang ne'u le sogs kyi zar bcug pa sogs rgyu mtshan du ma nas lo ltar nyon mongs gsog pa las mi 'dug pas/ slan chad ngos kyi yab rje rdo rje 'chang gi dgongs rdzogs dang / gdung brgyud rim byon gyi sku rim du dmigs phyag gnyer las thog pa rnams nas mi dpon bzhi la bkod pa byas pa'i gdan sa chen po 'di dang nye 'khor grong khyim so so'i mgo byed rgan po bcu dpon sogs ji ltar rigs pa rdzi bo re ched mngags bskos pa'i lung pa yas mas so so tha dad du bya rdzi yang dag byed dgos la lto dang mgo bstun mi dpon rgan po bya rdzi sogs la bca' ga dag min dang bstun pa'i gsol ras sprod lugs dang / nad kyis btab ste shi na ma gtogs nor zog chud zos byung tshe do dam pas so so la nyes pa ched dang bstun pa'i chad pa phyis sdom kheg pa re byed dgos pa ni/

'o skol gangs can pa rnams chos rgyal mes dbon rim can gyi bka' khrims 'og na ma 'khod pa gcig kyang med pas de bzhin gyi bsgo ba bzang po dgos pa ma zad gdan sa 'di'i phan bde'i rtsa ba gdung brgyud la rag las pas shes ldan gzur gnas yod na nges kyi ngag bkod 'di rgyal ba'i bka' bzhin blang bar rigs so// //ces sa skya pa kun blos me glang zla 12tshes la bris// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ gdung brgyud rim can gyis ri rgya klung rgya la thugs gal shin tu che bar mdzad pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
